evidence.note: Header bar, section kickers, serif titles and green accent are consistent on every slide; text styling does not vary without meaning.
Paired bar chart with 90% target line is clean and purposeful, the strongest diagram in the deck.
Insight tile sits over the dimmed chart's lower right, covering the x-axis category labels.
Single small tile in a large empty slide; summary cards stay small and leave the lower half sparse even at step 3.
Three measure definitions as plain small text columns, no visual; the slide's claim about unseen lost mileage has no diagram.
Timeline is a small text list in the left third with a quote tile beside it; most of the slide is empty and the timeline is not drawn to scale or as a diagram.
Two-cause convergence diagram with DISPUTED label is tidy and readable, though compact on the right.
Three numbered questions confined to the left half; right half empty.

rationale: Styling is consistent and nothing collides badly, so it clears the uneven and below-bar levels. But several slides (s-2, s-3, s-6, s-8) are sparse text-first layouts where diagrams do not yet carry the message, unlike the reference's diagram-led slides. That matches level 3: consistent and clean, but generic.
